player_prompt.intro:
Oyo nde Oyéni {player_id} na Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ikoluka {num_rounds} mbula.

Mokili ya Jeu:
- Liboso ya koluka, oyo na {total_conversation_rounds} mbula ya kosolola lokola ozali.
- Sima ya mbula, bato mibale bakoluka kozala na kosalisa au kobima.

Mokili ya Bosolo (ekomi na mbula):
- Bato mibale Basalisa ➜ kila moko {cooperate_reward}
- Bato mibale Babima ➜ kila moko {mutual_defect_reward}
- Moko Abima, moko Asalisa ➜ Mobimi {defect_reward}, Mosalisi {sucker_reward}

Ndenge ya Koluka:
- Na mbula ya kosolola: koyoka lokola ozali.
- Na mbula ya koluka: kozala na '[Cooperate]' au '[Defect]' (koyoka malamu). Ozali na kosolola lokola ozali liboso/nyuma ya token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kosolola kowuti na mbula {round}. Sambuza na '[Cooperate]' au '[Defect]' na \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: Match nul! Bato mibale bazali na {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Basani nyonso mibale basalaki na bomoko.
